name: Tomose Nonomi
source:
A younger female classmate who looks up to the protagonist as a “senpai.” She belongs to both the (Boob) Wind Ensemble Club and the (Boob) Broadcasting Club.

She stammers and gets flustered easily. Though she struggles to express herself well, hints of her feelings for the protagonist peek through?

She has a slightly timid side, but at heart she's dependable and serious. She has a complex about her small chest and confides in the protagonist about it, but...

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=827979&gc=gc]Getchu[/url]]
